provenance.quote: QUESTION 1: Shall the City of Eagle River adopt a charter ordinance creating Section 2-105 of the Eagle River Municipal Code to establish term limits for the offices of Mayor and Alderperson by: 1. Limiting service as Mayor or Alderperson to four consecutive two-year terms; 2. Requiring a six-year period before a person who has served four consecutive terms may again serve in the same office; 3. Prohibiting a person who has served four consecutive terms as Mayor from immediately serving as an Alderperson, and prohibiting a person who has served four consecutive terms as an Alderperson from immediately serving as Mayor; and 4. Counting terms served both before and after enactment of the ordinance when applying these term limits.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Reduce the Burnett County Board of Supervisors from 21 members to 15.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve reducing the board to 15 members.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject the proposed reduction from 21 to 15 members.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Set a limit of four consecutive two-year terms as mayor or alderperson, counting terms served before and after the ordinance. After four consecutive terms, a person would have to wait six years to serve in that same office again and could not immediately switch between mayor and alderperson.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve all of those term-limit, waiting-period and office-switching rules.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed set of term-limit rules.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Add Chapter 2.53 to the city’s ordinances to create a Citizens’ Advisory Healthcare Action Committee.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the ordinance creating the committee.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed ordinance creating the committee.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Approve Charter Ordinance 2026-02 to abolish the city treasurer’s office and establish an administrator-treasurer office.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve replacing the treasurer’s office with an administrator-treasurer office.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Require a majority vote of city electors to approve proposed development agreements, development projects, sales and leases at the GM/JATCO sites for projects costing more than $450 million.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve requiring a majority vote of city electors for those proposed agreements, projects, sales and leases above $450 million.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Create a Citizens’ Advisory Healthcare Action Committee to develop a healthcare action plan every two years and provide a public process for community input on healthcare.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve creating the committee for those planning and public-input purposes.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Ask whether the town should adopt Barron County’s general zoning ordinances.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Support adopting the county’s general zoning ordinances in the town.
measureRecords.noMeans: Oppose adopting those county zoning ordinances.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Use a nonpartisan primary to nominate all candidates for elected town offices.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve nominating all candidates for elected town offices through a nonpartisan primary.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Have the Town Board appoint the person who holds the Corning town clerk’s office.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve having the Town Board appoint the town clerk.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Ask for nonbinding advice on whether the Town Board should adopt Lincoln County’s zoning ordinance to govern land use and zoning development in the town.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Advise the Town Board to adopt the county zoning ordinance.
measureRecords.noMeans: Advise the Town Board against adopting the county zoning ordinance.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Have the Town Board appoint the town clerk instead of having town voters elect the clerk.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve appointment of the town clerk by the Town Board.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep election of the town clerk by town voters.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Have the Town Board appoint the town treasurer instead of having town voters elect the treasurer.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve appointment of the town treasurer by the Town Board.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep election of the town treasurer by town voters.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Adopt the proposed charter ordinance, without changes, to limit the village president and village trustees to two consecutive two-year terms.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve adopting that ordinance and its term limits.
